summary: PJM Interconnection moves to withdraw its October 29, 2026 filing and October 30 amendment in ER27-330. It says it resubmitted the same tariff revisions in ER27-454 after using the wrong eTariff filing codes.
ask: Withdraw the October 29 filing and its amendment in ER27-330, and treat ER27-454 as the proceeding for the same tariff revisions.

points.point: PJM moves to withdraw its October 29, 2026 filing in ER27-330.
points.quote: withdraw its October 29, 2026 filing in this proceeding

points.point: PJM says it used eTariff codes for compliance filings instead of code 10 for a new section 205 proceeding.
points.quote: PJM inadvertently used eTariff filing codes applicable to compliance filings and not eTariff filing code 10 applicable to the initiation of a new proceeding under section 205.

points.point: PJM says the refiling only corrects metadata and does not change the substance of the October 29 filing.
points.quote: Such refiling to correct the metadata does not in any way affect the substance of the October 29 Filing.

points.point: PJM says the re-submittal was driven only by the need to revise the metadata.
points.quote: To be clear, the re-submittal was driven by the sole purpose of making the ministerial revision to the metadata.

throughLine.text: Concerns PJM's reliability backstop procurement tariff rules and a filing-code error. The motion never cites the E-7 show cause order.
